title: Watch all four gold medal triumphs from Amy Hunt's historic European Championships
originalTitle: Watch all four gold medal triumphs from Amy Hunt's historic European Championships
content:
Relive Great Britain's Amy Hunt's "iconic" European Championships where the sprinter won four gold medals with victories in the women's 100m, 200m, 4x100m relay and the mixed 4x100m relay.
